name: Agent-Reach
description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
one_liner: Gives an AI agent the ability to read and search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub and more, without paying for each platform's API.
buyer: A social-media manager or brand strategist who needs to track what's being said about their brand or market, without a $500/month listening tool.
business_use_cases: A brand manager builds a daily competitor-mention digest pulled from Reddit, Twitter and YouTube comments.
A marketing agency offers 'what's trending in your niche this week' reports to small-business clients.
A solo content creator builds a tool that surfaces trending Reddit threads in their niche to turn into posts.

money_ideas.idea: Wrap it as a hosted 'social listening' SaaS billed per brand/keyword tracked.
Sell one-off trend reports to small businesses who can't afford enterprise listening tools.
Charge usage-based API credits to other developers who want the same cross-platform search without building it.

steal_this: This weekend, build a Slack bot that posts a daily 'what people are saying about you' digest for a specific niche (e.g. local restaurants) and sell it to 5 businesses.
